metadata.division: DIVISION 1-1-3. RULES OF CONSTRUCTION AND INTERPRETATION

content.title: 1-1-3-2. Correction of obvious errors.

faqs.a:
Nothing in this Code shall be construed as a limitation upon the power of the Director of Community and Economic Development to correct obvious typographical or compositional errors, provided:
  1.	Such corrections shall not change the legal effect of this Code or any part thereof.
  2.	Such correction will be reported to the Planning Commission and the City Council.
